site.name: Counter & Crumb
site.tagline: A buyer's desk for air fryers and kitchen thermometers.
site.description: Question-shaped buying guides, side-by-side comparisons and a fully sourced product register for countertop air fryers and kitchen thermometers. Every outbound link is marked sponsored; every claim carries a source.

author.name: The Counter & Crumb desk
author.note: Editorial desk of Counter & Crumb. Product pages are assembled from the sources recorded in the product register; no product is described from memory.

disclosure.operating_agreement_sentence: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
disclosure.strip: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Outbound product links are sponsored and may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you.

measurement.endpoint_note: Point this at your own collector (see _src/analytics_sink.py). If it is unreachable the browser falls back to a local queue and nothing is lost silently.
measurement.salt_note: Hash salt is supplied by the server at runtime; it is never shipped to the browser.

events.name: Page view
events.fires: Once per page load, on every page including 404.
events.referrer_host_note: Only the hostname of the referring page, and only when it is a different host. Never a URL, a path, a query string or a fragment.

events.name: Outbound affiliate click
events.fires: When a reader clicks a sponsored product link, before navigation.

events.name: Guide read depth
events.fires: At 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% scroll depth on a guide or comparison page.

events.name: Comparison table interaction
events.fires: When a reader sorts, filters or expands a row in a comparison or register table.

events.name: Reader capture
events.fires: When a reader submits the newsletter form.

publishing.notes: Every published guide is added to the sitemap and the feed in the same build step.
